messages:
nina: Quick note: product wants a "preflight" card in the cost dashboard that shows per-variant unit cost + estimated cache savings and flags noisy signals before a rollout. Low-ingest approach preferred.

harry: Agree. We should avoid storing raw events for every call. Hybrid sampling + hourly weighted rollups seems best.

zhou: Add sample metadata per event: sample_rate, route_policy, is_canary, and cache_saved_tokens. No prompt text. Example event we can send:
```json
{
  "ts": 1769993333,
  "route_id": "r_api_reply",
  "tenant_id": "t_99",
  "model_id": "rw-2.0",
  "variant": "q8_0",
  "tokens_in": 16,
  "tokens_out": 98,
  "cache_hit": true,
  "cache_saved_tokens": 60,
  "sample_rate": 0.005,
  "route_policy": "sticky_v1",
  "is_canary": false
}
```
(we will not include user text).

ellie: UX: card shows sparkline + stacked bars for variants. Toggle: "Estimated (sampled)" vs "Exact (100% routes)". For sampled rows show a confidence badge and tooltip: "estimated from X% sampled telemetry; 95% CI shown".

nina: On ingest: sampled events are fed to a fast aggregator that increments counters by key: (hour, route, model, variant, cache_hit). Aggregator columns: sum_w_tokens_out, sum_w_cache_saved, sum_w, sum_wx2, sample_count. We can compute weighted-estimates and approximate CI without storing raw events.

harry: Include routing context so we can tell if sticky changes drive cost deltas. Add optional rollout_id when available.

ingest-bot: deploy: telemetry-v3-sampled-rollups pushed to staging at 1769993400. Aggregator prototype running on staging-shard-5.

zhou: Math note: inverse-prob weighting = sum(x / sample_rate). For variance estimation keep sum((x^2)/(sample_rate^2)) so var approx = sum_wx2 - (sum_wx)^2 / sum_w. We'll expose est_sum, ci_low, ci_high, effective_n.

ellie: Product wants a guardrail: flag variant if est unit cost increases > 12% with p < 0.05. UI should allow changing threshold per-org. Also allow muting noisy routes.

nina: Privacy: for private deployments allow model/variant obfuscation (model_hash) and a tenant-level mapping. Add console permission econ.variant_inspect to control who sees model names.

harry: Edgecases: multiple cache layers. If client reports cache_layers, store them; otherwise use combined cache_saved_tokens + provenance="combined".

zhou: Validation: billing team requested a daily reconciliation job comparing weighted estimates vs full-capture for a sample set of tenants. If mismatch > 1% open an alert. We'll run this on staging first.

ellie: Microcopy: card should show "Estimated" vs "Exact" label and a small "why this matters" blurb explaining cache impact on unit-econ. Export CSV must include sample_rate and effective_n for audits.

nina: Action items: (1) zhou to PR schema + aggregator pseudocode; (2) harry to add routing/rollout fields to telemetry; (3) ellie to produce compact card mock + guardrail settings; (4) infra to run ingest sims for 0.1/0.5/1% sample curves and post numbers. I'll tag billing/product in the RFC.
